about: The held-out set for `hxq owner`: questions a reviewer wrote without the owners' wording and without the ranking's tuning, the honest reading of how far a paraphrase finds its owner. `owners` are the types whose answer it is (a member of one counts); `atLeast` is the floor the test holds. Never reword a question to fit a doc. Read by unit.query.OwnerParaphraseTest.

questions.question: after I read x, could a method call before I use it again make x hold something else
normalize a filename so the same source opened twice is keyed once
does anything consume what the final statement in braces evaluates to
a class name with no package prefix, which class is it given imports and the same package
keep haxe --wait processes alive to make repeated compiles cheap
is this command line argument an option, an option's value or a positional
pick the grammar from the file extensions given on the command line
in Foo.bar(), is Foo a type name or a variable
remove a method only if nothing anywhere calls it
